reason: Authoritative 2026-05-14 state of OpenAI Realtime API. Implementer MUST use these exact model IDs (gpt-realtime-2, gpt-realtime-translate), endpoints (/v1/realtime/client_secrets, /v1/realtime/calls), event names, voice names (marin/cedar), and the @openai/agents-realtime SDK. Prior training data is stale — deprecated gpt-4o-realtime-preview* IDs will be silently broken.

Project-wide reuse principles. Demo intentionally shares one translation atom across overlay + /translator and one useRealtimeSession hook across modes — guide ensures we don't accidentally split that.
Frontend/backend cohesion. Three Route Handlers (token, translate, gate middleware) must align with their frontend consumers — guide informs the contract design.
